messages:
AJ (Support): Flagging urgent hand-off for Greenline Labs  trial stuck at onboarding step 3, ingest errors and token quota spike. Renewal signal: medium-high. Need CS to own comms and mitigation plan. :warning:
Lina (CS Ops): Ack. Can you paste the core error and tenant id?
AJ (Support): Error snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:33Z ERROR ingest: failed to create embedding: quota_exceeded (rate_limits) tenant=gl-241
```
Tenant: gl-241. Customer is on a paid trial using our hosted API with auto-scaling disabled.
Maria (CSM): Thanks  I have customer call scheduled tomorrow 10am PT. They mentioned latency and missing examples in quickstart. Renewal at 45 days. This looks like activation -> revenue risk.
Nathan (AE): FYI this account was close to conversion last week, good product fit. We should avoid surprise downtime.
Sam (Solutions): Repro steps: SDK v2.1, sending 50 concurrent embed requests, no batching. Likely burst triggered rate limits. Quick fix: reduce concurrency or enable burst policy on Dedicated side.
AJ (Support): We tried a temporary soft-throttle reply to the client at 14:05  client saw 429s and then retried aggressively, making it worse.
Lina (CS Ops): Proposed comms plan (short): 1) Immediate: send acknowledgement to customer within 30m with mitigation steps and ETA; 2) Short-term: enable per-tenant burst allowance & apply temporary token quota increase; 3) Post-mortem + enable batching/SDK guidance before renewal touch.
Maria (CSM): I'll take ownership of customer comms. Draft message suggestion: "We're sorry for the friction  our support team has applied a temporary quota relief and we'll run a joint session to optimize your integration. We'll follow up w/ steps before your next milestone." Want to include a scheduled troubleshooting session link.
Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the technical runbook for the session. Short checklist:
- Confirm tenant quota values (gl-241)
- Apply temporary increase: +2x tokens, 24h window
- Enable SDK batching sample and CI test
- Monitor error rate and KPIs (latency, 429 count)
Lina (CS Ops): How do we handle approvals for quota increase? Ops needs ticket and AE sign-off. Nathan can you approve a 24h emergency bump?
Nathan (AE): Approve up to 2x for 24h. Please add note to CRM and mark as "emergency quota bump".
AJ (Support): I'll open internal ticket with logs and mark severity=P2. DeployBot: applied rate-limit rule patch to edge?
DeployBot: patch deployed to edge-rate-limiter at 14:18 UTC, rule gl-241 temporary-burst=true (no rollback detected).
Maria (CSM): Action items summary (I'll DM owners): 1) AJ  open ticket + attach logs (ETA 15m); 2) Lina  coordinate quota tweak + Ops ticket (ETA 30m); 3) Sam  prepare troubleshooting agenda & SDK examples (ETA 2h); 4) Nathan  confirm approval (done); 5) Maria  send customer acknowledgement & schedule 60m session (ETA 30m).
Lina (CS Ops): I'll also add a short playbook entry to the activation runbook so next time it's faster.
AJ (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks  will wait for the session. We've lost two key demo users today." :disappointed:
Maria (CSM): I'll lead the session, focus on quick wins (batching, backoff), and escalate infra recommendations if they want higher throughput. Will update thread after call.
Sam (Solutions): I have a short snippet for batching to share during the call:
```
const batch = client.batchEmbeddings({maxBatchSize: 16});
await batch.add(texts);
await batch.flush();
```
Simple and reduces concurrent token pressure.
Maria (CSM): Great. Closing loop for now  next update after troubleshooting session. :white_check_mark:
